The description incorrectly maps the x-axis ticks (10, 11, etc.) to years starting from 1990. The reference and context indicate these ticks represent the years 2010, 2011, etc. This fundamental error invalidates the entire temporal description of the data.
The red line (EU-27) starts at a value of approximately 84, not 85.
For the x-tick 11 (representing 2011), the red line's value is approximately 82, not 75.
The blue line is a solid line, not a dotted/dashed ("пунктирана") line.
For the x-tick 11 (representing 2011), the blue line's value increases to a peak of approximately 69. The description incorrectly states that it falls to 55.
